name: VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026
short_description: A full-marathon event in Đồ Sơn, Hải Phòng, Vietnam, taking place on December 13, 2026, organized by VnExpress and FPT Online.
ai_summary: VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for December 13, 2026, at Đồ Sơn in Hải Phòng, Vietnam. Organized by VnExpress and FPT Online, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration for the event has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km) to suit different runner levels
Organized by VnExpress and FPT Online, an established event organizer
Scenic Đồ Sơn venue in Hải Phòng, Vietnam
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so details on sign-up are unavailable

faqs.question: When is the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is scheduled to take place on December 13, 2026. The event will be held at the Đồ Sơn venue in Hải Phòng, Vietnam, and is organized by VnExpress in partnership with FPT Online.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance options at this event: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of varying experience levels to select a suitable distance.

faqs.question: Who organizes this marathon?
faqs.answer: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is organized jointly by VnExpress and FPT Online. These organizations are responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at the Đồ Sơn venue in Hải Phòng, Vietnam, on December 13, 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: As of now, registration for the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 has not yet been announced. Interested runners will need to wait for further updates from the organizers, VnExpress and FPT Online, regarding when sign-ups will become available.
